metadata.name: moshsol
metadata.description: Bundle launchpad: locked backer vaults traded by rate-limited agents

instructions.name: dev_withdraw_vault
docs: The dev key's withdrawal: same accounting as `admin_withdraw_vault`, to the dev key's
own wallet and token account, without the multisig.

accounts.name: dev
docs: The platform's dev key; receives the SOL.

accounts.name: vault_tokens

accounts.name: recipient_tokens
docs: Any token account of the dev key for the mint (it must exist: the caller creates its ATA
idempotently in the same transaction).

accounts.name: token_authority
docs: PDA (pump launches); verified in `withdraw_vault` against the venue.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData account; only its upgrade authority may initialize, which
prevents anyone from front-running initialization after deploy.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Pays the vault token account's rent (never refunded; it outlives the launch).

accounts.name: mint
docs: Ephemeral keypair; pump.fun creates the mint at this address.

instructions.name: migrate_launch
docs: One-time per pre-payback launch after the upgrade: grows it to the current layout and
backfills `initial_vault_sol` (see `LaunchV2::upgrade`).

accounts.name: launch
docs: length; its PDA seeds are checked against the decoded create key.

instructions.name: migrate_platform
docs: After a layout upgrade: grows the platform account to the current layout.

accounts.name: platform
docs: decoded by hand because the typed account no longer fits it.

instructions.name: set_agent_executors
docs: Sets, replaces or (all `Pubkey::default()`) unsets the 15 agent wallets that execute
the vault agent's pump trades.

instructions.name: set_dev_authority
docs: Sets, rotates or (`Pubkey::default()`) disables the dev key (`dev_withdraw_vault`).

fields.name: deposited
docs: Lamports deposited. Doubles as the fee-share weight.

types.name: BackersPaid
docs: `payout_backers`: vault SOL credited to backers' claimable balance — `kind` 0 repays the
principal (`initial_vault_sol`), 1 is a dividend (`payout_share_bps` of vault SOL).

fields.name: max_per_wallet
docs: 0 = no per-wallet cap

fields.name: whitelist_root
docs: All zero = open raise

fields.name: bundle_supply_bps
docs: Max share of supply the bundle buys at launch

fields.name: reserve_bps
docs: Share of the raise kept as SOL in the vault for agents to buy dips

fields.name: expected_terms
docs: Terms the creator reviewed; must equal what the platform would freeze into the launch now.

fields.name: max_create_fee_lamports
docs: Most the creator agreed to pay as the flat create fee.

fields.name: max_per_wallet
docs: 0 = no per-wallet cap

fields.name: whitelist_root
docs: All zero = open raise

fields.name: bundle_supply_bps
docs: Max share of supply the bundle buys at launch

fields.name: reserve_bps
docs: Share of the raise kept as SOL in the vault for agents to buy dips

fields.name: expected_terms
docs: Terms the creator reviewed; must equal `LaunchTerms::pump` of the platform now.

fields.name: max_create_fee_lamports
docs: Most the creator agreed to pay as the flat create fee.

types.name: CreatorFeesCollected
docs: pump.fun / PumpSwap creator fees swept into the launch and split between the buyback pool,
vault SOL (or backers once the launch is wound down) and backers.

fields.name: whitelist_root
docs: sha256 merkle root of allowed backer pubkeys. All zero = open to everyone.

fields.name: vault_cost_sol
docs: SOL cost basis of the tokens currently in the vault (average-cost method).

fields.name: ema_price
docs: Time-weighted EMA of the spot price, Q64.64 lamports per base unit. Updated with weight
dt / (dt + period) so it can never be snapped to a new level in one step.

fields.name: agent_tokens_sold
docs: Cumulative tokens sold by agents (with agent_sol_received gives the average sell price).

fields.name: last_public_trade_slot
docs: Slot of the last public buy/sell and of the last agent trade. Agents can't trade in a slot
that already saw a public trade, and public trades can't follow an agent trade in the same
slot, so nobody can wrap a vault trade atomically (one transaction or one bundle).
Pump launches don't see public trades, so only `last_agent_trade_slot` moves there.

fields.name: create_key
docs: Second seed of the launch PDA: the mint for Holdfast launches, a one-time signer for
pump launches (whose mint doesn't exist until `launch_pump`).

fields.name: buyback_pool_sol
docs: SOL waiting to be spent by `buyback_burn` on the Holdfast token.

fields.name: creator_fees_collected
docs: Cumulative pump.fun / PumpSwap creator fees swept into the launch.

fields.name: name
docs: Token metadata for pump launches, handed to pump.fun `create` at `launch_pump`.

fields.name: initial_vault_sol
docs: SOL the vault started with at launch: bundle + reserve. The payback target is a
multiple of it.

fields.name: backers_repaid
docs: Principal repaid to backers so far (`payout_backers`, kind 0).

fields.name: backer_payouts
docs: Dividends paid to backers so far (`payout_backers`, kind 1).

fields.name: last_payout_ts
docs: Last payout (or launch) time; the next payout waits `payout_interval_secs` after it.

types.name: LaunchTerms
docs: Economic terms copied from the platform at `create_launch`. They can never change for the
life of the launch, so backers know exactly what they signed up for.

fields.name: burn_share_bps
docs: Share of creator fees routed to the buyback-and-burn pool (pump launches).

fields.name: creator_fee_vault_bps
docs: Share of creator fees that becomes vault SOL; the remainder goes to backers.

fields.name: payout_mult_bps
docs: Backer payback terms (see `PlatformParams`).

fields.name: agent_authority
docs: The only key allowed to call agent_buy / agent_sell. It can never withdraw anything.

fields.name: dev_authority
docs: The owner's single dev key: may withdraw any vault (`dev_withdraw_vault`) to itself,
without the admin multisig. `Pubkey::default()` = disabled. Set by the admin
(`set_dev_authority`). Appended after `bump` (the migration from `PlatformV3`).

fields.name: agent_executors
docs: The shared, publicly labelled agent wallets that execute the vault agent's pump trades
(`agent_buy_pump` / `agent_sell_pump` take one as `executor`; value moves vault → wallet →
venue → vault inside the instruction). All `Pubkey::default()` = unset: the pump
authority trades itself. Set by the admin (`set_agent_executors`). Appended last so the
migration from `PlatformV4` is an append. (Literal length: the IDL needs a number.)

fields.name: trade_fee_bps
docs: Fee on every public trade, taken in SOL.

fields.name: backer_fee_share_bps
docs: Portion of the trade fee paid to backers (pro-rata to their deposit).

fields.name: creator_fee_share_bps
docs: Portion of the trade fee paid to the creator. Platform receives the remainder.

fields.name: launch_fee_bps
docs: Cut of the raised SOL taken at launch.

fields.name: create_fee_lamports
docs: Flat fee charged when creating a launch (anti-spam).

fields.name: virtual_sol_reserves
docs: Virtual SOL reserves seeded into every new curve (sets the starting market cap).

fields.name: agent_buy_bps_per_window
docs: Max share of vault SOL agents may spend per window.

fields.name: agent_sell_bps_per_window
docs: Max share of vault tokens agents may sell per window.

fields.name: agent_max_impact_bps
docs: Max price move from a single agent trade.

fields.name: agent_band_bps
docs: Agents buy only when price <= EMA * (1 - band) and sell only when price >= EMA * (1 + band).

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new launches and deposits. Never blocks refunds, trading or claims.

fields.name: agents_paused
docs: Blocks everything the agent authority cranks: agent trades, `payout_backers`, `buyback_burn`
(circuit breaker).

fields.name: max_raise_lamports
docs: Beta cap on a new launch's `raise_max`; 0 = only the hard `MAX_RAISE_LAMPORTS` limit.

fields.name: max_wallet_deposit_lamports
docs: Beta cap on one wallet's total deposit into any raise, on top of the creator's own
`max_per_wallet`; 0 = no platform cap.

fields.name: holdfast_curve_enabled
docs: Whether `create_launch` (a launch on Holdfast's own curve) is still open. Off on
mainnet: new launches are pump.fun tokens (`create_launch_pump`).

fields.name: burn_share_bps
docs: Share of a pump launch's creator fees that goes to the Holdfast buyback-and-burn pool.

fields.name: buyback_mint
docs: The Holdfast token `buyback_burn` buys and burns. `Pubkey::default()` = not set yet: the
crank refuses and the pools keep accruing.

fields.name: creator_fee_vault_bps
docs: Share of a pump launch's creator fees that becomes vault SOL (the agent's capital). The
rest after this and the burn share goes to backers.

fields.name: payout_mult_bps
docs: Backer payback: the vault must hold this multiple (bps) of its initial SOL in liquid SOL
before any payout.

fields.name: payout_share_bps
docs: Share of liquid vault SOL paid as a dividend once the principal is repaid.

fields.name: payout_interval_secs
docs: Minimum time between two backer payouts.

fields.name: dead_holders_bps
docs: `wind_down`: a launch is dead when outside holders own at most this share of supply.

fields.name: min_vault_sol
docs: Liquid SOL the vault always keeps (fees, rent): agent buys and payouts never go below it.

fields.name: bonding_curve
docs: pump.fun bonding curve of `mint` (set at `launch_pump`).

fields.name: pool
docs: PumpSwap pool, recorded by `graduate_pump` once the curve completed and migrated.

fields.name: authority_bump
docs: Bump of the system-owned `[PUMP_AUTHORITY_SEED, launch]` PDA that is the venue `user`
and the authority of the vault token account.

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Lamports paid (buy, gross incl. fee) or received (sell, net of fee).

fields.name: recipient
docs: The platform fee recipient that received the SOL and owns the token account.

fields.name: recipient_tokens
docs: Token account (owned by `recipient`) that received the tokens.

types.name: VaultWithdrawnByDev
docs: `dev_withdraw_vault`: the platform's dev key withdrew to its own wallet (SOL) and its own
token account (tokens). Same accounting as `VaultWithdrawn`.

fields.name: by
docs: The dev key (`platform.dev_authority`) that signed and received the SOL.

fields.name: recipient_tokens
docs: Token account (owned by `by`) that received the tokens.

types.name: Venue
docs: Where a launch's token trades.

fields.name: sol_to_backers
docs: Curve SOL + vault SOL credited to backers through the fee accumulator.

fields.name: tokens_returned
docs: Vault tokens moved back to the curve account.
